text: inside of hmsc-int the front page quad in the top corner for objects some one pretty much nuked it when we removed the old buildings types like a reeeetard idk why but [Image #1] that is all it is now which is absolutely useless cant even do anything with it lol it should have building data
resolution: The Objects (OBJ) tab's building branch had been gutted to a flat 'Motel Room / 6 semantic pieces / + place' card when the old Building type was removed — no 3D, no real data, useless. Restored it to inspect like every other object: buildings are V24 prefabs that DECOMPOSE to semantic pieces, so buildPrefabView() stamps the prefab to real placed pieces (GAME_BUILD.placed.stamp), recentres them on the union envelope so the orbit camera frames the whole composition, and the ModelViewer now draws them via the same PlacedPieceMeshes renderer F2/iso use. ModelViewer/ModelScene gained an optional 'pieces' prop. Below the viewer a new PrefabInfo panel lists the building's data (theme, piece count, and each decomposed piece's label/kind/material/cutout-edit/grid-cell). The + on the viewer drops the prefab into the place layer. Verified the cart bundles clean (esbuild, exit 0).
